name: Blended Roasted Veg Cottage Cheese Soup
desc: Roasted carrots, peppers, zucchini, tomatoes and onion blended with cottage cheese and bone broth into a creamy high-protein soup.

source.title: Blended Roasted Veg Cottage Cheese Soup
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 3 large carrots, peeled and cut in 1 in pieces
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut in 1 in pieces

ingredients.raw: 1 large zucchini, cut in 1 in chunks
3-4 bell peppers (red, yellow or orange), seeded and cut in chunks
1 1/2 tsp kosher salt, plus more to taste

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a large sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the carrots, onion, zucchini, tomatoes, garlic and peppers with the olive oil, turmeric, oregano, black pepper, red pepper flakes and salt. Spread in one layer (use two pans if crowded).
Roast 35-45 min, tossing halfway, until the carrots are tender and the edges are browned. Cool 10 min.
Blend the vegetables with the cottage cheese and 16 oz of the broth until completely smooth, working in batches. Add more broth to reach the thickness you like.
Taste for salt, then warm in a pot over medium-low before serving.
tips: About 15-20g protein per serving. Swap in any vegetable you have (eggplant, celery, broccoli).
